# FrankDiary (od.frankbase.com / ood.frankbase.com / diary.frankbase.com)
> A privacy-first, offline-first, client-side end-to-end encrypted personal diary and zero-knowledge data storage vault.

## Mission & Principles
- Your data belongs to you. The server stores ciphertext, not readable personal information.
- Offline-first: Operates 100% without internet connectivity, mandatory accounts, or tracking.
- Client-side cryptography: All encryption and decryption happen strictly on the user's device using Argon2id (RFC 9106) and AES-256-GCM / XChaCha20-Poly1305.
- Zero backdoors: Master keys are never transmitted to or stored on any server.

## Product Modes
- Mode 1: Fully Offline Diary (Local SQLite WASM / OPFS storage, in-memory client search).
- Mode 2: Portable Encrypted Backups (.fbe container format, unencrypted Markdown / JSON exports).
- Mode 3: Optional Zero-Knowledge Cloud Sync (Cloudflare Workers, D1 database, and R2 object storage).
